chapter: Earl Hines, Chicago and later gigs
title: John Collins's mother's band, Joe Williams and Bird at DeLisa's
summary: A barbershop group with Dan Grissom singing, Joe Williams as doorman at the Regal, and Charlie Parker sitting in at DeLisa's.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: I know you mentioned yesterday that the time you were in Chicago that -- we were talking about John Collins. You said John Collins was playing with --

John was over at a barbershop at the back of -- I think it was in the back of a barbershop his mother used to play. And Dan Grissom was singing with them. I don't know if he was singing regularly with them, but I know
Yeah, that's what I wanted to figure out--
Dan was in the singing (inaudible) with John's mother.
Yeah. And Joe Williams was doorman over there at the Regal Theater for a while, you know.

I don't remember. I'd have to go back and find out. Joe might tell you if you asked him, but I'd have to go back and find out. But Joe always could sing good, you know, even when he -- before he went into deLisa -- Mike deLisa's club. He -- a lot of guys sang at Mike deLisa's club, you know. A lot of -- I know before anybody knew Bird, he used to go out there and jam. He used to go out there and sit in when he first left Kansas City.
